query:
SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM agent_changesets
    WHERE user_id = $1
      AND course_id = $2
  ) AS "has_changesets!",
  (
    SELECT count(*)
    FROM agent_changeset_entities e
      JOIN agent_changesets cs ON cs.id = e.changeset_id
    WHERE cs.user_id = $1
      AND cs.course_id = $2
      AND agent_changeset_is_open(cs.status, cs.expires_at)
  ) AS "open_entity_count!"
